title: Job Search ROI Tracker
subtitle: Search Channel ROI + Accept vs. Continue Planner
data_vintage: Tab 1: Channel benchmark rates — BLS JOLT 2024 (job openings/hire rates), LinkedIn Economic Graph 2024 (response rates), SHRM 2024 (time-to-fill). Tab 2: Zero maintenance (user-entered inputs only). Annual spot-check recommended.
regulatory_citations: BLS JOLT 2024 (Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey — hire rates by sector)
LinkedIn Economic Graph 2024 (InMail response rates, application-to-interview ratios)
SHRM 2024 Workforce Survey (recruiter channel benchmarks, time-to-fill)
IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-25 (income year used for NPV base)
BLS OEWS May 2023 (wage benchmarks for target salary validation)
downstream_handoff_note: Tab 2 accept verdict → AL-28 (Career Break & Reentry Cost Engine) if user chooses to continue searching and a gap is likely. Offer accepted → AL-25 (Offer Negotiation Calculator) for counter-offer strategy.

mcp_tool_definition.name: track_job_search_roi
mcp_tool_definition.description: Model the expected ROI of job search effort by channel (referral, LinkedIn, recruiter, direct apply, cold outreach, job boards) using geometric probability models and NPV. Tab 1 computes EV/hour and channel ranking by expected offer timeline. Tab 2 computes the NPV delta of accepting a current offer vs. continuing to search, with break-even months and runway analysis. Returns two AP2-compliant mandates under job_search_roi_record: channel_roi (Tab 1) and accept_vs_continue (Tab 2). Accepts AP2 inbound from offer_negotiation_record (AL-25).

current_salary_usd.description: Current annual salary in USD (or last salary if unemployed).

target_salary_usd.description: Target annual salary for the new role, USD.

hourly_rate_usd.description: User's effective hourly rate for opportunity cost calculations (annual / 2080).

channels.description: Array of job search channels to model.

response_rate_pct.description: % of applications that receive any response.

interview_to_offer_pct.description: % of interviews that convert to an offer.

hours_per_app.description: Hours spent per application (research + prep + submission).

current_offer_usd.description: Current offer in hand, annual USD (Tab 2).

liquid_savings_usd.description: Liquid savings / runway available during continued search, USD.

monthly_expenses_usd.description: Monthly essential expenses during job search, USD.

expected_weeks_remaining.description: Expected weeks remaining to receive a better offer (from Tab 1 portfolio median or user estimate).

discount_rate_annual_pct.description: Annual discount rate for NPV calculations (default 3%).

years_to_model.description: Years over which to model the salary differential NPV.
